lastCompletedStory.title: Publicar um instalador curl-avel e documentar a instalacao empacotada com fidelidade sobre a assinatura

nextStoryContext: New root-level `install.sh` (executable, chmod +x) is the curl-able installer: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eduardocaminha/cam-cli/main/install.sh | bash`. It detects os/arch (darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, linux-x64, linux-arm64 -- the exact four names US-003's build-release.sh publishes as dist/gateship-<target>), resolves the release tag either from GATESHIP_VERSION (override) or by listing https://api.github.com/repos/eduardocaminha/cam-cli/releases and grepping the first "tag_name" (NOT /releases/latest -- every release is currently published --prerelease per ADR-0055/US-003's release.yml, and GitHub's /releases/latest endpoint excludes prereleases entirely, so it would 404 forever until the ADR-0054 rename window closes and a non-prerelease Release is cut), downloads the matching asset from https://github.com/eduardocaminha/cam-cli/releases/download/<tag>/gateship-<target> into a private mktemp file, then copies it to BOTH `gateship` and `gship` under $HOME/.local/bin (override with GATESHIP_INSTALL_DIR). It is strictly additive: it never touches, removes, or overwrites a pre-existing `cam` binary (ADR-0055 -- that removal stays a deliberate operator step). On darwin it strips the Gatekeeper quarantine bit post-install (`xattr -d com.apple.quarantine ... || true`) because a binary that arrives via download is quarantined even though it is ad-hoc signed (the ad-hoc re-signing happens upstream in build-release.sh/release.yml, not in install.sh -- install.sh only clears quarantine, it does not codesign). README.md's Install section was restructured: Option A is now the packaged curl installer (was 'Option A: From source'), followed by a new '#### About the signature (macOS)' subsection that tells the truth -- ad-hoc signed, explicitly NOT notarized by Apple (no Apple Developer account, operator decision 2026-08-01), with the literal `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine ~/.local/bin/gateship` / `~/.local/bin/gship` remediation commands a user actually runs if Gatekeeper still blocks execution. The old 'Public distribution note' (which said distribution wasn't happening yet) was folded into and superseded by this new subsection since distribution via install.sh + Release assets is now real. From-source build is now 'Option B' and the no-compile shim path is now 'Option C' (renumbered, content otherwise untouched). No npm/manifest publish was added or implied (ADR-0055: the manifest stays publishable but not published this cycle). scripts/file-size-budget.json was not touched -- README.md carries no ceiling.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed the list-releases response schema uses `tag_name` as the field name (matches install.sh's sed extraction) and that GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases includes prereleases for public repos (unlike /releases/latest, which explicitly excludes them -- this is why install.sh lists releases instead of hitting /releases/latest). Docs fetch did not explicitly restate newest-first ordering of the list endpoint; this is well-established, widely-relied-upon GitHub API behavior (matches the web Releases page order) and was not independently re-verified beyond the fetched page.
